data.title: CompX v1 ASA lending borrow
data.description: Borrows a base ASA from a CompX lending market against accepted LST collateral. Collateral must be in the market's on-chain accepted_collaterals set (often a cross-market LST).
data.summary: Borrows a base ASA from a CompX lending market against accepted LST collateral.

data.title: CompX v1 ASA lending repay
data.description: Repays outstanding base-ASA debt on a CompX lending market.
data.summary: Repays outstanding base-ASA debt on a CompX lending market.
